cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: SABI's coding assistant is implemented as an agentic tool-use loop (plan -> propose tool -> permission gate -> execute -> verify) with permissioned filesystem and shell access, so code generation and autonomous action-taking are the same feature, not a bolt-on. The same agent that drafts an enterprise plan (THINK engine) can scaffold and build the project that implements it, on-device.
